controls.columns_shuffled: no (released order, to match the published runs)

metric_defs.f1: Bayesys half-credit F1 (true adjacency with wrong or no orientation = 0.5 TP)

controls.columns_shuffled: per-row (arm: released order or shuffled seeds 1-5)

bayesys.json.orientation_rule: F1_random: undecided pairs at random (per-run seed); F1_lower: earlier column -> later column

metric_defs.F1_random: directed F1, undecided pairs oriented at random
metric_defs.F1_lower: directed F1, undecided pairs oriented earlier column -> later column (the authors' index rule)
metric_defs.F1_bayesys_half_credit: Bayesys-style F1: a true adjacency with the wrong or no orientation counts 0.5 TP
metric_defs.c: share of found true adjacencies with a committed arrow
metric_defs.q: share of committed arrows on true adjacencies that point the right way
